label: Bun
host: Node 22.23.1 (spawns the process and talks to it over stdio)
notes: idle.mjs prints 1 + 1 with console.log and waits for stdin to close; guest.mjs uses Bun's console async iterator for stdin; Bun's Node-compat stdout costs it about 15 ms at startup, so it is avoided.
Memory: cgroup charge per added process, median of 3 rounds of 20; USS 6.86 MiB, PSS 8.16 MiB.
Start: median of 40 spawns until the host reads the first line.
Tool call: per-call median over 50,000 calls after 5,000 warm-ups; median of 500-call batches 82.47 µs; 151.63 µs of CPU per call across host and process.
Compute: the loop runs inside the process and is timed with performance.now(); default JIT tiers.
